The EGG Genius is a smart device that enhances outdoor cooking with precise temperature control. This intelligent device seamlessly connects to your smartphone, tablet, or computer, allowing you to manage and monitor your egg's internal temperature from anywhere. Advanced algorithms adjust the variable-speed blower to maintain your desired cooking temperature with remarkable accuracy, while dual probes provide real-time feedback on both the cooking environment and your food.

Intuitive alerts keep you informed of cooking progress and temperature fluctuations, ensuring consistently delicious results. The EGG Genius adapts to your cooking style, automatically lowering temperatures to keep food warm when cooking is complete and intelligently managing airflow when the dome is opened.

  • Temperature range: Up to 400°F / 204°C
  • Includes: 2 industrial-grade thermometer probes
  • Compatibility: iOS, Android, and web browsers
  • Connectivity: Wi-Fi enabled with automatic reconnection

The EGG Genius seamlessly integrates with your existing setup, enhancing your culinary capabilities and freeing you to focus on the art of outdoor cooking. By providing precise control and valuable insights, this device becomes an indispensable part of your cooking arsenal, trusted by both novices and seasoned pitmasters alike.

 

The Egg Genius ensures you never lose control of your cook, regardless of your environment. Powered by the latest firmware (Version 4.0 and above), the device now features three versatile connection modes to suit any situation:

Cloud Connect: The standard mode for complete control. Monitor your EGG from the grocery store or the office via the internet. This mode enables full history logging and note-taking.


Local Connect: Internet down? No problem. This mode allows your phone to communicate with the Egg Genius through your home Wi-Fi router, even if your external internet connection is offline.


Direct Connect: Going off the grid? Connect your phone directly to the Egg Genius signal—no router or internet required. This is ideal for tailgating, camping, or remote cooking locations.

products.title: Flat Pizza & Baking Stone (Diameter 18 in / 46cm) (for 2XL, XL)
products.body_html:
Pizza, sourdough bread, focaccia, or a delicious apple pie: with the Baking Stone, you can open your own bakery at home. Place the stone on the grid in the Big Green Egg and bake bread with a crispy crust and pizzas with a crunchy base.

The Baking Stone is one of the favorite accessories among Egg users. Place the pizza stone directly on the grid (in combination with the convEGGtor) when you light the Egg, so that it warms up gradually. As the Baking Stone retains heat well, you can easily keep pizzas and cakes warm before serving them (but of course, there's a high risk they'll be gone in no time).

products.title: Medium Hell Hands™
products.body_html:
Take control of the heat. Hell Hands™ are premium, heat-resistant gloves built for serious protection and dexterity. Rated up to 900°F and reinforced with Armortex® patches and Kevlar® stitching, these premium cowhide gloves let you grip, lift, or reposition a hot grate, deflector, or pizza wedge with a steady hand. So, you can focus on the cook, not the heat.  

Proven Performance: Extensively tested in extreme heat conditions, Hell Hands allow you to manage and move cookware up to 900°F (482°C). 

Strategic Protection: Palms, fingers, and knuckles are protected with heat-resistant Amortex® patches. Back-of-hand pull pockets make removal simple, even when Hell Hands are hot.  

Handier Than Tools: Whether you’re moving a cooking grid, lifting a convEGGtor, or adjusting components mid-cook, Hell Hands™ provide protection and dexterity.

products.title: Quick Light™ Kit
products.body_html:
Our Quick Light™ charcoal grate and starter tool give you a better way to start the fire. Whether you're a seasoned grill master or new to cooking on the Egg, the Quick Light™ Kit gives you faster, more reliable ignition, less ash buildup, cleaner hands, and more even-burning coals. Light your charcoal from below, every time you start your Egg.

Ready to Cook Sooner: Efficient ignition from the bottom of the Egg helps you reach cooking temperature more quickly.

Cleaner hands: No need to bury a fire starter or rearrange charcoal by hand. Simply dump charcoal into your Egg’s firebox and light it from below.

More Even Heat: The honeycomb grate improves airflow to help minimize hot spots and maintain consistent cooking temperatures. 

Reduces Ash Buildup: Larger grate openings allow ash to fall through for easier cleanup.

Built to Last: Heavy-duty 430 stainless steel can stand up to decades of high-heat cooking.

Compatible with M, L, XL and 2XL Eggs. 

(Quick Light Tool does not work with cast iron charcoal grate.)
